title: Miraj Collective recap — Muslim founders retreat cites Incorruptible on 'Fortifying the Founder'
summary: Smith recapped a Miraj Collective weekend, a retreat for Muslim founders built around the idea of fortifying founders by waking them to their own power and to the global change their ambition could carry. He cited Incorruptible in that framing and posted video of Ashequl Hoque breaking down what the term means.
blockquote: In his recent book Incorruptible, Eric Ries highlights the importance of being a fortified, principle driven founder.
attribution_title: Muslim founders retreat (recap by Mikaeel Ahmed Smith)
